2. Any new rates of IS/JSA/ESA/SPC will apply from the first day of the first benefit week which
commences on or after 06.04.26. DMs can find the new rates in the benefit uprating schedule and
benefit desk aids and should bear them in mind when reading examples in the ADM that contain benefit
rates.


Housing costs non-dependant contribution – IS/JSA/ESA/SPC

3. Where a non-dependant lives with the claimant, a contribution may be appropriate. The contribution is

made in the form of a deduction from the allowable housing costs1. (see DMG 23756, DMG 44586 or
DMG 78500 et seq) The new rates of deduction are:




Gross weekly income                       Deduction


less than £192.00                         £20.40


Not less than £192.00 but less than £279 £46.85


Not less than £279 but less than £365     £64.35


Not less than £365 but less than £485     £105.20


Not less than £485 but less than £605     £119.85


£605 or more                              £131.45




     1 IS Regs, Sch 3, para 18; JSA Regs, Sch 2, para 17; ESA Regs, Sch 6, para 19; SPC regs, Sch II,
                                                                                                   para 14
